summary: User said they work at Harbor Clinic on the night shift. Mara poured tea and said the glare would eat their eyes.
Mara claimed she captained the Pell ferry in her twenties. User knew that was a boast, not fact.
User corrected themselves: they left Harbor Clinic and now catalogue charts at the maritime archive.
Narrator note: the ferry captain story was in-character bluster; Mara never held that job.
